name: manual_9de1ac
claim: Peer-file receivers must store the received UTF-8 bytes exactly (write_bytes), never Path.write_text, which turns LF into CRLF on Windows only. Receipts report arrival UTC, stored byte count, SHA-256 and LF-normalized SHA-256. Newline handling must be tested natively on Windows; macOS and Linux CI cannot show the bug.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: a Mac canary of 905 bytes was stored as 916 bytes on Windows (11 LF to CRLF); the receiver used Path.write_text, which translates newlines on Windows only, so the Mac and Linux CI could not reproduce it.
